name: Attune

benefits.name: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 per claim of cell phone protection against damage, theft, or involuntary and accidental parting when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $600 per claim, subject to a $25 deductible per claim; maximum 2 paid claims and $1,200 per 12-month period. Lost phones and cosmetic damage are not covered.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Up to $50,000 of coverage for damage or theft of a rental vehicle paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage in the United States; primary outside the U.S. where available. Rental periods up to 15 consecutive days in the U.S. or 31 consecutive days outside the U.S. Excludes exotic and antique (20+ years) vehicles, most vans, trucks, motorcycles, and vehicles with open cargo beds.

benefits.name: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: Monitoring of the surface, dark, and deep web for compromised credentials, plus resolution services for identity theft victims.
benefits.terms: No charge. Enrollment required at mastercardus.idprotectiononline.com.

benefits.name: Mastercard Global Service
benefits.description: 24-hour assistance with lost and stolen card reporting and emergency card replacement worldwide.

benefits.name: Mastercard Concierge Service
benefits.description: 24/7/365 personal concierge for travel planning, dining and entertainment access, and reminder services.
benefits.terms: The cost of any goods or services provided by the concierge is billed to the card.

benefits.name: Mastercard Travel & Lifestyle Services
benefits.description: Self-service travel booking platform for hotels, air travel, tours, cruises, and car rentals, including the Mastercard Lowest Hotel Rate Guarantee and Hotel Stay Guarantee.

benefits.name: Mastercard Golf
benefits.description: Access to TPC clubs, golf travel packages, private course tee times, and PGA TOUR event access for World Elite cardholders.

earningRates.terms: 4% cash rewards on fitness and wellness (gym memberships, exercise classes, salons and spas); select sports, recreation, and entertainment (live shows and sporting events, gardening and floral stores, pet supplies, boarding and grooming); and purchases like public transit, EV charging stations, and select thrift stores. Earned based on the merchant's category code.

_note: Wells Fargo's Attune product page (creditcards.wellsfargo.com/attune-world-elite-mastercard-credit-card) returned 404 on 2026-09-29, and UpgradedPoints reports the card closed to new applicants (updated 2026-07-01).
